func (*Client) Close() error
func (*Client) Describe(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Ticket) (string, error)
func (*Client) OnSettled(handler func(context.Context, protocol.Outcome)) error
func (*Client) Start(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Start) (protocol.Job, error)
func Attach(ctx context.Context, conn duplex.Conn, options runtime.Options, handler Handler, events Events) (*Client, error)
func Dial(ctx context.Context, url string, options runtime.DialOptions, handler Handler, events Events) (*Client, error)
func Open(ctx context.Context, t *tunnel.Tunnel, handle protocol.Handle, options runtime.Options, handler Handler, events Events) (*Client, error)
type Caller interface{Describe(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Ticket) (string, error); Start(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Start) (protocol.Job, error)}
type Client struct{Peer *runtime.Peer}
type Events struct{Settled func(context.Context, protocol.Outcome)}
type Handler interface{Supervise(ctx context.Context, client *Client, params protocol.Supervise) (protocol.Outcome, error)}
